acceptedComparisonDelta: Allow an explicitly empty operational MAC on a proven stopped endpoint with the original requested MAC retained in the creation contract. All other endpoint fields remain bound by the original validator.
boundary: Keep original journal and backup. Do not repeat original stops or backup. Use the original remaining phases under the original lock and a separate durable receipt. Unknown actions require inspection and the migration is forward-only.
scope: One forward-only continuation from the exact original known pause and first filesystem stop.
